text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After finishing our errand. Believe 
mentioned she had plans to meet a friend, 
so I tagged along—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend was there, dressed in 
comfortable, easy-to-move-in clothes.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yaho-yaho~. Alright, let's head out for 
some mountain climbing!
choice_data_list: That mountain? Looks pretty steep.
That mountain? It looks pretty steep.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Actually, I bought a ton of mountain 
climbing gear at a sale the other day. So 
like—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to take on a slightly more 
serious mountain. So I asked Believe-chan 
to come along with me~

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this way. I'll pick out your 
equipment.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look, I found a lake-ish thingy. Hey 
hey, wanna go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No good.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of fallen leaves over 
there making it slippery, so I excluded it 
from the route.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"We can see that lake from the summit. 
—Let's go."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Hear that? They're thinking this 
through for you, so don't you go wandering 
off on your own, okay~?
choice_data_list: Wait, I wasn't even planning on going?!
But I wasn't even trying to go!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Climbing this? ...Heheh. Nice. This is 
getting exciting.
choice_data_list: I-I wonder if I can do it...
I-I wonder if I can do it...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I can do it. That is the path I have 
chosen.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'll go ahead and set up a rope. If we use 
that as a lifeline, we should be able to 
climb safely.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's the only handhold? 
...Seriously? Ahaha! Looks fun!
choice_data_list:
E-Even with a lifeline, this is 
terrifying!!?

E-Even with a lifeline, this is scary, 
isn't it!!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. Please calm down. There is no 
need to rush to the next thing right 
away."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Let's catch our breath. Stretch both arms 
out... bend your legs... and think about 
your next move.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Right there. Good. Start with your 
feet ...and focus on three points of 
contact.
choice_data_list:
Right. Plant your foot and reach your hand 
toward where you want to go...!

Yeah. Hook your foot, reach towards where 
you want to go...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! We made it to the summit! We did it. 
Peace.
choice_data_list: Ah... What a great view!
Yeah... what a great view!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, you really saved me~. Thanks to 
Believe-chan taking the lead.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let me make it up to you big time 
sometime, okay? Oh, wanna go on a movie 
date? I'll treat you to a ticket.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...No. There's no need to thank me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Since it was entrusted to me, I just 
wanted to see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Believe-chan. I'll let 
you know again if mortar goes on sale~.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Tran-san. You really don't need to 
keep thanking me... over and over."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I was only... doing my job.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see. ...Still, it's precisely 
because you're like that that I wanted to 
ask you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Like, you always work for your own sake, 
right, Believe-chan? And then you see it 
all the way through, right?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—And you have no idea how much everyone 
around you is being helped.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing through what you take on is 
unexpectedly difficult. Yet, you... never 
break that promise. Never."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm just saying 'thank you,' that's 
all. Make sure you accept it properly, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Transcend's words, I remember 
the party that Curren Chan and the others 
threw for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing to worry about after 
all. By staying true to herself as a 
professional, Believe had built wonderful 
relationships with her friends—
choice_data_list: Everyone really puts their trust in you!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really how it is?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: …………I'm glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I returned to the academy together with 
Believe. Before parting ways at the end, I 
spoke to her.
choice_data_list: I had so much fun today! Thank you!
Oh no... my legs feel like lead...!
Oh no... my legs are like jelly...!

You really know everything about the 
mountains, that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I returned to the academy together with 
Believe. Before parting ways at the end, I 
spoke to her.
choice_data_list: I had so much fun today! Thank you!
Oh no... my legs feel like lead...!
Oh no... my legs are like jelly...!

You really know everything about the 
mountains, that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Then I'm glad.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll try going on my own next time!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It's still too dangerous for you to be 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please call for me. I'll come right away.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You should stretch a bit more. Also, eat 
some meat and soybeans...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: If anything happens, please LANE me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I'll repay as much of it as I can.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No... compared to people who climb 
mountains for a living, it's nothing at 
all...
choice_data_list: Still, you were so reliable!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I study occasionally using books and 
videos, after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll try to learn a bit more. And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Next time... I want to make sure I do an 
even better job.
